audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in either layer explains how Purge picks its target. Both just call it "shotgun legs".
audit.why: Riot's own text: Purge prioritises enemy champions Urgot has recently struck with other abilities. So the moment Corrosive Charge tags Nasus, the wave stops being cover — Purge will pick him out through the minions. That is why standing in the wave to farm feels safe and then suddenly is not, and it is the actual reason to respect his Q as a setup tool rather than as poke.
audit.corrected: Purge locks on to whoever he last hit with another ability; a Q that tags you removes minion cover.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns listed the same ability twice — "Urgot Disdain (Flip)" and "Urgot Disdain" — and gave no numbers for either.
audit.why: Duplicating one ability across both bullets wastes the only cooldown section on the page. The two numbers that matter are Disdain at 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s and Purge at 12/9/6/3/0s, and the Purge scaling is the important one: it goes from a real cooldown to no cooldown and no mana cost at rank 5.
audit.corrected: One bullet each for Disdain and Purge, with per-rank cooldowns and the rank-5 Purge behaviour.
sources: champ-data/_kits/urgot.json — E and W cooldown and cost fields

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither layer mentions that Disdain shields Urgot.
audit.why: Disdain shields him while he charges. A Nasus who saves his empowered Q for the moment Urgot commits is spending his biggest hit into a fresh shield. The correct read is to punish the miss, not to trade into the connect.
audit.corrected: Disdain's charge carries a shield — his engage absorbs your burst window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Purge is described everywhere as unavoidable DPS with no range given.
audit.why: Purge is 490 units and it slows Urgot himself while he channels it. That makes it a leash, not a chase tool: stepping outside 490 ends it, and he pays move speed for every second he holds it. Nasus last-hits at 255 range with Siphoning Strike but can position at Spirit Fire range, so the gap is manageable once the number is on the page.
audit.corrected: Purge is 490 range and self-slows him; step outside it and the shred stops.
sources: champ-data/_kits/urgot.json — W Purge range and slow flag

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer calls his ultimate a "fear-execute" without ever naming Fear Beyond Death or stating that the execute is threshold-gated.
audit.why: The execute only becomes available if the impaled champion falls below a health threshold. That turns Fury of the Sands from a generic durability button into a specific counter — its bonus maximum health is what keeps Nasus above the line.
audit.corrected: Fear Beyond Death executes only below a health threshold; the R health bonus is the answer to it.
sources: champ-data/_kits/urgot.json — R Fear Beyond Death, execute flag
champ-data/_kits/nasus.json — R Fury of the Sands, increased health

audit.whatIsWrong: The full chart gives Urgot all of stages 1-5 including level 6; the content chart gives Nasus stage 5 and stage 7.
audit.why: Nasus loses this lane at 47.31% over 427 games, so Urgot holding the early stages is right — but the level-6 stage is where Fury of the Sands answers the execute, and both charts should agree on that.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side and phases[6].side moved to Nasus to match the content chart. Difficulty label HARD 7/10 left alone and is correct here.

edits.before: Wither online — it's your get-off-me button, not a kill tool yet. Hold it for Urgot's engage, never open with it.
edits.after: Purge locks on to whoever Urgot last hit with an ability — once his Corrosive Charge tags you, minions will not hide you.

edits.before: E lets you stack safely from range when Urgot zones you. Spirit Fire the wave under tower; every stack denied is his only real win condition.
edits.after: Wither is online but it does not stop Disdain — he charges through minions and hurls you, and the charge shields him on the way in.

edits.before: Still Urgot's window — respect Disdain (Flip) fully. Passive lifesteal plus Fleet means he must commit hard to actually dent you; make those commits cost.
edits.after: Still his window. Purge drops from 12s to 3s as he ranks it, so the safe gap between his shred windows shrinks every level — farm at Q tip range.

edits.before: Fury of the Sands flips dives: pop R, Wither Urgot, and suddenly the stat-check runs your way. First real fight you're allowed to take.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death is an execute — pop Fury of the Sands for the bonus health, stay above the threshold, and Wither him after the flip.

edits.before: - Urgot Disdain (Flip): matchup-defining — His engage. Wither him after it. Track it before every engage. - Urgot Disdain: Charges, knocking enemies aside and flipping the first champ behind him. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Urgot Disdain: 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s — it shields him on the way in, so his engage eats your burst. - Urgot Purge: 12/9/6/3/0s — free and near-permanent at rank 5, and it locks on to whoever he last hit with an ability.

edits.before: His engage. Wither him after it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: It shields him as he charges — 16s at rank 1, so punish the miss.

edits.before: Urgot wastes Disdain (Flip) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Stay outside Purge's 490-unit radius and last-hit at Q tip range.

edits.before: That is Urgot's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Purge reaches only 490 units and it self-slows him — step out and it ends.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Disdain hurls you behind him, straight into his legs and his combo.

edits.before: Auto-cancel your Q windups with his W shotgun legs and chunk you on cooldown
edits.after: Cancel your Q windups with Purge's shotgun legs and chunk you on cooldown

edits.before: Land E flip into Q/W percent-max-HP burst to win every sub-6 trade
edits.after: Land Disdain's flip into Corrosive Charge and Purge to win sub-6 trades

edits.before: Hit his R fear-execute when you are low before your lifesteal and stacks come online
edits.after: Hit Fear Beyond Death's execute when you are low, before your stacks come online

edits.before: Fury of the Sands' bonus HP plus Wither lets you survive his R fear-execute and win the single committed all-in.
edits.after: Fury of the Sands' bonus HP keeps you above Fear Beyond Death's execute threshold — survive it and win the all-in.

notes: I did not use the 'dash' flag the kit library derives for Urgot's Corrosive Charge — that reads like a false positive from the flag builder (the Q is a lobbed charge, and Riot's text describes no movement). Same pattern as the knockup flag on Teemo's Noxious Trap; the flag deriver looks worth a pass. This is the one matchup in the slice where the HARD difficulty label matches the data.
